children: Bitway is scheduled to unlock about 225.24 million BTW on 02 Mar 2027. The token unlock covers an amount equal to 14.96% of the circulating supply.

Four vesting contracts unlock together, concentrating the release into one batch. Tokens previously held under those contracts become available at once, creating a large increase in available supply and a potential source of selling pressure for BTW.

title: Bitway: Token unlock releases 225.24M BTW - 02 Mar 2027
